data_fields.name: forced_band_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (percent of rolls, half forced hit and half forced miss)

data_fields.name: gdr_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: gdr * max_damage / 100 floor on normal rule only

best_idea: A hit is one margin, to-hit minus evasion, with a small slice of rolls forced to hit or miss, and armour takes a uniform soak before health moves.
decision_why: The margin test is the right shape for the duel step, but the per-roll randomness (randomised evasion, coin-flip band, uniform armour soak) must draw from a seeded per-fight RNG logged in the fight record, or server-verified kills and replay (row 19) cannot reproduce a hit; keep the forced band as a tunable or drop it.
acceptance: A server test replays a seeded fight record and asserts every hit, miss and damage value is identical, and an independent recount of the margin formula over 10,000 seeded rolls matches the engine hit count.
